summary.text: Nicolle Grasse is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives from District 53, appointed in June 2024, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An ordained United Church of Christ minister and hospice chaplain, she is a former Arlington Heights village trustee.

paragraphs.text: Nicolle Grasse graduated from Rhinelander High School, attended the University of Wisconsin-Madison, and received a bachelor's degree from Elmhurst University and a graduate degree from Chicago Theological Seminary.

She began serving as a village trustee in Arlington Heights, Illinois, in 2021, and her career experience includes serving as an ordained minister in the United Church of Christ and as a hospice chaplain.
Grasse was appointed to the Illinois House on June 5, 2024, to replace Mark Walker (D).

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists her on the Agriculture & Conservation, Appropriations-Health and Human Services, Health Care Availability & Accessibility, House Human Services, Public Health, and State Government Administration committees.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she listed her key campaign messages as making health care more accessible and affordable, making housing, health care, property taxes and the cost of living more affordable, and protecting democracy while including the disenfranchised in the political process.
She named health care and human services as the areas of public policy she is most passionate about.
Ballotpedia lists Elizabeth Bauer (R) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.
